messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-20260324-01 in prod-eu — inference-serving embeddings queue latency > 2s over 5m. Auto-escalate in 3m if unacked. https://pd.example/INC-20260324-01

sam: taking pager (oncall). pinging oncall channel. I'll ack in PD.

sam: acked in PD - I'm the primary. Quick check: tailing inference logs shows 503s from model-gpu-03 and kvcache eviction spikes.

pagerbot: incident status: ack by sam at 3598765434. Escalation cancelled.

alice: joining — saw error rates jump after a config deploy ~10:12UTC. Deploy hash: d4c3b2. Rolling back?

ben: before rollback, can we try emergency mitigation: 1) scale inference-workers, 2) route some traffic to hosted fallback. If kvcache is thrashing, fallback could reduce RTT.

priya: customer-impact: Support flagged 2 high-priority customer complaints (AcmeCorp search is returning stale embeddings). Ticket #9876 references results missing recent docs. We should include that in status page note.

sam: doing quick scale now — running:```bash
kubectl scale deployment inference-worker -n prod --replicas=12
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference -o wide
```

carla: runbook step 3 says to disable background KV compaction if eviction > 80%. Can someone check the config?

alice: I pulled runtime config from model-gpu-03: kv_cache.eviction_rate=85% and compaction.enabled=true. Patching to false now.```yaml
patch:
  kv_cache:
    compaction.enabled: false
```

ben: putting a temporary routing override to send 20% traffic to hosted-variant-low-latency. Doing change in TrafficRouter UI.

pagerbot: routing override applied — 20% to hosted fallback. Monitor for errors.

josh: support update drafted: "We're investigating higher latency on embeddings in EU; some customers may see degraded results. We have an active mitigation and will update in 15m." Want me to send now?

priya: yes send, include link to PD and short mitigation steps. Add note: "no data loss, just degraded latency/results."

sam: metrics after scale + route change: p95 latency down from 2.3s -> 1.1s in 90s. Error rate dropping but model-gpu-03 still has high load. Looks like scaling helped.

alice: leave model-gpu-03 out of rotation, marking node as cordoned:```bash
kubectl cordon model-gpu-03
kubectl drain model-gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

carla: I'll take ownership for the full RCA and follow-up postmortem. Handoff to me in 30m if anyone needs to pass anything.

sam: noted. I'll stand by for any rollback needs and provide timeline of actions. Adding timeline to PD incident notes.

pagerbot: incident update: mitigation effective. p95 < 1.2s, errors reduced to baseline. Will monitor for 1h before declaring resolved.

priya: customer outreach queued. Support will follow up with AcmeCorp and link to status page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/20260324-01

josh: sent support note to AcmeCorp and internal CSM. They replied: "Thanks for quick action — we'll monitor."

carla: filing follow-up checklist: include deploy diff, node telemetry for model-gpu-03, kvcache settings, and traffic router change. Will schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow.

sam: thanks all. marking PD incident with retention tag and will hand to carla in 30m. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: note: if any re-escalation occurs, page sequence will resume.
